name: Nar'thalas Almanac

angles.text: Mages understand the immense scholarly value of recovered texts treating ancient arcane traditions, making contributions to the library's magical collection particularly meaningful.
Nar'thalas was once an ancient center of Kaldorei arcane scholarship before the Sundering shattered the old world, making an almanac bearing its name a poignant link to ancient night elven history.
Scholars and curators working within Alliance archives rely on enterprising adventurers to seek out rare manuscripts and expand the realm's gathered lore.

faq.answer: The Nar'thalas Almanac is an ancient manuscript of magical scholarship sought by curators to enrich a library's historical archives. Adventurers who recover such rare works deliver them into scholarly care so their preserved insights can be cataloged.

The almanac is presented to library scholars interested in ancient magical texts and historical archives. These curators actively seek additions to expand their shared institutional knowledge of the world's arcane heritage.
faq.q: Who is collecting the Nar'thalas Almanac?

faq.answer: Nar'thalas was an ancient Kaldorei center of learning and magical study dating back before the Great Sundering. Surviving texts associated with the name represent fragments of pre-sundering arcanery and elven knowledge.
faq.q: What does the name Nar'thalas refer to?

faq.answer: Many historical records and magical treatises were displaced, lost, or buried in ruins across Azeroth. Scholars rely on recovered writings to broaden their understanding of arcane currents and safeguard fragile records against total loss.
faq.q: Why are magical texts being collected for the library?

faq.answer: Scholars welcome any recovered treatises, tomes, or forgotten manuscripts that shed light on arcane theory and ancient history, continually seeking additions to enrich their shelves.
faq.q: Can other magical works be brought to the library?

faq.answer: The almanac represents a compiled record of study rather than a volatile forbidden artifact. It serves primarily as a valuable reference work for historians and practitioners studying historical magic.
faq.q: Is the Nar'thalas Almanac dangerous to handle?

sections.body: The Nar'thalas Almanac is a rare tome of arcane study originating from the ancient traditions of pre-Sundering night elven scholarship. For caretakers of grand archives, securing such a text rescues centuries-old lore from obscurity and adds a vital piece of history to the shelves. Adventurers who uncover these long-neglected works help bridge the divide between forgotten antiquity and modern scholarly understanding.
sections.title: A Relic of Ancient Study

sections.body: Archivists and researchers continually seek out lost treatises, field notes, and chronicles scattered across Azeroth. Bringing the Nar'thalas Almanac into a dedicated library ensures it will be safeguarded, cataloged, and studied rather than left to rot in ruins or fall into careless hands. Each salvaged volume offers scholars fresh insight into the arcane arts of past eras.
sections.title: Expanding the Archives

summary: The Nar'thalas Almanac is a rare scholarly manuscript of ancient magical study sought by archivists to expand their library's collection. Recovering the volume brings lost arcane lore into safe hands where researchers can study its forgotten insights.
